question: Team TS3004 changed its mind about speech recognition more than once. Was speech recognition in their final design, and in which of their four meetings did they last reverse their position on it?
answer: Yes, speech recognition was in the final design: in meeting d, Speaker B says they would include it after Speaker A says it was financially possible. Their last reversal was in meeting d, the fourth meeting; they briefly decided against it in meeting c, then decided to include it after all.
